|translation='''Title:''' Commander Evram Lajaie.

'''Card text:'''
If he is deployed on a Yavin 4, Hoth or Endor location card, Rebel starships may move to that system as a react.

'''Lore:'''
A renowned leader who specializes in space defense, particularly combat in orbit. Thanks to him, the Alliance discovered a structural weakness in the Death Star.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face says location card rather than site.
